mapper.select:
SELECT OP.*, CV.ConstrValDesc AS payTypeName FROM shopion.tOrdOrderPay OP INNER JOIN (SELECT * FROM wizardn.tCodConstrVal WHERE ConstrCode = 'cPayType') CV ON OP.PayType = CV.ConstrVal
AND OP.OrderNo = #{pOrderNo}
AND (OP.PayDate >= DATE_FORMAT(#{startDate}, '%Y%m%d') AND OP.PayDate < ADDDATE(DATE_FORMAT(#{endDate}, '%Y%m%d'), INTERVAL 1 DAY))
AND OP.PayDate IS NULL
ORDER BY OP.${sidx} ${sord} ORDER BY OP.OrderNo DESC, OP.PayNo ASC
SELECT * FROM shopion.tOrdOrderPay WHERE PgCode = 'TOSS' AND PgTradeNo = #{pgTradeNo} ORDER BY PayNo DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT OrderNo FROM shopion.tOrdOrderPay WHERE PgCode = #{pgCode} AND PgOrderCode = #{pgOrderCode} ORDER BY PayNo DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM shopion.tOrdOrderPay WHERE OrderNo = #{orderNo} AND PgCode IS NOT NULL AND PgCode != '' ORDER BY PayNo DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM shopion.tOrdOrderPay WHERE PgCode = #{pgCode} AND PgTradeNo = #{pgTradeNo} ORDER BY PayNo DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE shopion.tOrdOrderPay SET PayDate = NOW(), ReciptAmt = #{amount}, ReciptDate = NOW(), ChangeDate = NOW(), ChangeId = #{changeId}, ChangeName = #{changeName} WHERE OrderNo = #{orderNo} AND PayNo = #{payNo} AND ReciptDate IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT P.* FROM shopion.tOrdOrderPay P INNER JOIN shopion.tOrdOrder O ON O.OrderNo = P.OrderNo WHERE P.PgCode = 'KCP' AND P.PayType = '001000000000' AND O.OrderState = '주문접수' AND P.PayExpectDate IS NOT NULL AND P.PayExpectDate < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{graceMinutes} MINUTE) ORDER BY P.PayExpectDate LIMIT 100
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shopion.tOrdOrderPay ( OrderNo, PayNo, PayType, PayDate, PayAmt, PayFee, CardComp, ApprovNo, ApprovDate, ReciptBank, ReciptName, ReciptAccnt, ReciptDate, PayExpectAmt, PayExpectDate, PayExpectName, PgCode, PgOrderCode, PgTradeNo, State, Remark, RegistId, RegistName, RegistDate ) VALUES ( #{orderNo}, #{payNo}, #{payType}, #{payDate}, #{payAmt}, #{payFee}, #{cardComp}, #{approvNo}, #{approvDate}, #{reciptBank}, #{reciptName}, #{reciptNo}, #{reciptDate}, #{payExpectAmt}, #{payExpectDate}, #{payExpectName}, #{pgCode}, #{pgOrderNo}, #{pgTradeNo}, 1, #{remark}, #{registId}, #{registName}, NOW() )
